caption: The video captures a tight close-up of a pile of burning wood, with charred dark-brown and black logs arranged diagonally and vertically. A near-vertical split log stands left of center, a rounded log lies across the lower middle, and blackened logs fill the right side. Bright orange embers glow in the gaps, and white-to-yellow flames lick up around the log surfaces. The logs hold their positions while the flames flicker, curling, thinning, and reforming. The orange glow brightens and dims as the fire burns, and blue-tinted flame appears at the lower portion of the vertical log. Pale wisps of smoke drift upward on the right, shifting shape over time. The overall brightness of the flames rises and falls in an ongoing, flickering manner rather than growing or dying out.
